name: Michigan
status_why: No statewide count on the night: each county and town reports its own, and the state's results site shows scripts a challenge. Oakland County's Clarity results may be read later, labelled partial.
system: No statewide election-night reporting (the Department of State says local clerks post unofficial results on their own sites; official results later on the Michigan Voter Information Center). Counties use Clarity ENR (Oakland) or PDF reports (Wayne).

results_page.label: Michigan Voter Information Center: official results

election.how_to_find: Official results after the state canvass.

feeds.updates: Not live: after the state canvass
feeds.note: 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' to the script on 2026-10-09; readable in the Browser pane (kit carried files out as base64).

feeds.address: Oakland County Clarity: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/MI/Oakland/<EID>/current_ver.txt -> /<EID>/<ver>/json/en/summary.json, electionsettings.json; EIDs are linked from elections.oaklandcountymi.gov (127074 and 126183 linked on 2026-10-09)
feeds.note: 200 on 2026-10-09; EID 127074 version 379092, 145 contests from Governor down; settings show filterbyvotetype and showvotetypedetails. Oakland's own elections.json list is empty, so EIDs come from the county's page.

feeds.address: Wayne County: https://www.waynecountymi.gov/Government/Elected-Officials/Clerk/Elections/Election-Results-Candidates/November-3rd-2026-General-Election (PDF summary, precinct-by-precinct PDF, county and local race PDFs)
feeds.updates: election night (unofficial PDFs), then official PDFs
feeds.note: Read in the Browser pane 2026-10-09; the Aug 4 page lists 'Official Summary Report' and 'Official Precinct by Precinct' PDFs.

races_in_feed: Statewide (Governor, AG, SOS, Supreme Court, education boards, university boards), Congress, Legislature, county, city, township, school, judges: each county reports its own share.
local: Yes, all 83: Oakland (Clarity, address above), Wayne (PDFs, address above), Macomb, Kent, Washtenaw, Ottawa (not checked live; candidate-list addresses in state_local_mi.py).
how_counted: Each county and town reports its own count; absentee counting boards report as their own precincts.
count_order: Absentee counting boards (AVCB) reported as their own precincts.
vote_types: Clarity counties can split absentee counting boards (AVCB) from precincts; Michigan reports absentee counting boards as their own 'precincts' (Oakland's Absent Voter Counting Board schedule was posted for the primary). Useful for count order.

certify.body: the Michigan Board of State Canvassers
certify.rule: Completes the canvass no later than the 20th day after the election (Mich. Comp. Laws 168.842).
certify.local_rule: County canvass within 14 days (Mich. Comp. Laws 168.822).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: mvic.sos.state.mi.us (Cloudflare JS challenge, 403, 2026-10-09); the rest of michigan.gov answers scripts 403 (CLAUDE.md).
scout_plan: Readable with care, county by county. Statewide and congressional totals on the night must be summed from counties: start with the counties on Clarity (Oakland confirmed; check the other large counties' results pages for Clarity EIDs in late October) and read Wayne's PDFs if John agrees (or link out). Show each race's 'counties reporting' honestly; until most counties are machine-readable, a statewide total will be partial, so the page should say which counties are in. Official numbers come from MVIC after the canvass (Browser-pane carry-out).
